open_errors.issue: Ila's demonstration lie is called a small lie, which whitens only the fingertips. The text whitens them 'to the second joint', the depth used for her middling lie in ch 14.
open_errors.fix: Limit the white to the first joint.

patches.find: She watched them go white, nail beds first, to the second joint.
patches.replace: She watched them go white, nail beds first, to the first joint.

open_errors.issue: At grey light Kunal's hands are 'ordinary flesh again, not wax'. A few lines later, and through ch 16, his tips are still the colour of tallow.
open_errors.fix: Keep the tips wax-coloured at dawn.

patches.find: His hands were stiff and prickling, ordinary flesh again, not wax.
patches.replace: His hands were stiff and prickling, flesh again to the last knuckle, though the tips stayed wax.

open_errors.issue: The broken-promise strike kills only Kunal's right fingertips: later he cannot pinch with the right and signs left-handed. Ch 21 describes both hands' tips going grey and Ila speaks of 'ten dead fingertips'.
open_errors.fix: Confine the strike to the right hand.

patches.find: The pink in his fingertips went waxy, then grey, as if a hand had wiped the blood out of them.
patches.replace: The pink in his right fingertips went waxy, then grey, as if a hand had wiped the blood out of them.

patches.find: with ten dead fingertips, having been given a refusal and a debt I couldn't pay.
patches.replace: with five dead fingertips, having been given a refusal and a debt I couldn't pay.

open_errors.issue: Kunal says he has shown Ila three ways 'in nine days', but in the same chapter his petition margin counts day twenty since the binding.
open_errors.fix: Align the spoken count with the margin count.

patches.find: I've shown you three ways in nine days, and you're alive.
patches.replace: I've shown you three ways in twenty days, and you're alive.

open_errors.issue: Ila's count passes three hundred strokes before she cuts the bench and shelf, yet she then gives the total as two hundred and ninety.
open_errors.fix: Give a total above three hundred.

patches.find: "Two hundred and ninety strokes," said Ila.
patches.replace: "Three hundred and forty strokes," said Ila.

open_errors.issue: The lakes run Mirror, Drum, Eye. Standing at the Eye, the Drum is nearer and the Mirror beyond it, but the text reverses them.

patches.find: The Mirror was behind them, and the Drum behind that.
patches.replace: The Drum was behind them, and the Mirror behind that.

open_errors.issue: Kunal's 'and I came home' was said in the snow cave dug on the Hollow Moon's lip (ch 11), not in a hut.

patches.find: he had said, in the hut on the Hollow Moon
patches.replace: he had said, in the snow cave on the Hollow Moon

open_errors.issue: In ch 7 Mini ran inside Ewe's Rest to tell everyone that the star was named for her, so Dhanu already knew. In ch 19 he reacts to the naming as news. What is new to him is that Ila wrote it down.
open_errors.fix: Make Ila's news the recording, not the naming.

patches.find: "I named a star for her," she said.
patches.replace: "The star I named for her," she said. "I wrote it down."

open_errors.issue: Dhanu is the same generation as Kunal (33) and has known him thirty years, so he cannot have laid the lake-hut hearth thirty winters ago.

patches.find: Thirty winters I've lost to my own hearth.
patches.replace: Ten winters I've lost to my own hearth.

open_errors.issue: In ch 22 Dhanu corrects Kunal: Dhanu's people made the walnut rule and Kunal taught it to the council. In ch 24 Kunal says he made Dhanu swear to it.
open_errors.fix: Kunal made the council swear to Dhanu's rule.

patches.find: I made Dhanu swear to the walnut rule
patches.replace: I made the council swear to Dhanu's walnut rule

open_errors.issue: In the ch 2 council it was Chetu who argued for selling the licence for grain. Bhim argued for refusal.
open_errors.fix: Attribute the grain argument to Chetu.

patches.find: I read it twice in the hall while Old Bhim argued about barley.
patches.replace: I read it twice in the hall while Chetu argued about grain.

open_errors.issue: Ch 23 says Ila took the pencil case from Kunal. Ila kept the case in ch 9, and in ch 29 Kunal is still carrying the leads inside his shirt.
open_errors.fix: Ila takes leads from his coat; she does not take them over.

patches.find: He had not been able to pinch one tonight, and she had taken the case from him without a word.
patches.replace: He had not been able to pinch one tonight, and she had reached into his coat for them herself without a word.

open_errors.issue: Ila lays her bare hand on the carving, then marks the pencil 'on her glove' in the same sentence.

patches.find: and marked with the pencil on her glove where her fingers ended.
patches.replace: and marked with the pencil on the stone where her fingers ended.

open_errors.issue: The callback 'as he had put his hand on the lamp-oil jar in the kitchen' refers to an event that never happens on the page. The gesture shown was his hand on the tower's north wall (ch 1).
open_errors.fix: Point the callback at the north wall.

patches.find: as he had put his hand on the lamp-oil jar in the kitchen.
patches.replace: as he had put his hand on the cold north wall of the tower.

open_errors.issue: The faint east line of ch 3 was seen from a roadside cairn on the Neshar road, running east over a shoulder within two days of the Fair. Ch 32 remembers it 'on the scree' and 'along the east wall', and plots the valley above the Kuhl cut.
open_errors.fix: Restore the ch 3 setting and place the valley east of the Neshar road.

patches.find: She was back on the scree on the first night, with the pale blue line burning along the east wall, broken at the fourth light, a valley that was on none of her sheets.
patches.replace: She was back on the Neshar road on the first night, with the pale blue line running off over the eastern shoulder, broken at the fourth light, toward a valley that was on none of her sheets.

patches.find: She found the east wall of the Hollow Moon, and the blank above the Kuhl cut where the valley should have been.
patches.replace: She found the Neshar road above the Fair meadow, and the blank east of it where the valley should have been.

open_errors.issue: Book 2 is the 31st winter, so Harish's payment was 61 winters ago. Bhim, Meera and the queen in person all say sixty-one. The queen's own letter and Ila, who measures exactly, say sixty.
open_errors.fix: Use sixty-one in the letter and in Ila's statements.

patches.find: Of the Shilak post. Sixty winters ago.
patches.replace: Of the Shilak post. Sixty-one winters ago.

patches.find: Sixty winters ago the pass began to close.
patches.replace: Sixty-one winters ago the pass began to close.

patches.find: Sixty winters. The Closing Law, written the next spring.
patches.replace: Sixty-one winters. The Closing Law, written the next spring.

patches.find: Udai had been one of two men on a mountain sixty winters ago
patches.replace: Udai had been one of two men on a mountain sixty-one winters ago
